description: Files permitted to add schedule:/cron: triggers or GitHub-API polling loops (scripts/schedule-trigger-guard.mjs, run in PR Fleet Rules). Every entry needs a live canon/automation-registry.jsonl id: the mandate (.claude/rules/event-driven.md) allows a clock only for inherently time-based work, with the registry observing it. An entry should be REMOVED when its file loses the schedule or polling loop; keep this list small.
